visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a purple long-sleeved shirt with 'WISH' on it and blue denim shorts, stands in a stone-paved driveway. He is positioned between a black Tesla Model Y on the left and a green Mini Cooper on the right, gesturing with his hands towards both vehicles. The background shows a modern house with beige brick walls and several windows under bright natural daylight. (2) The man squats down on the stone driveway, looking directly into the camera and speaking with expressive hand gestures. He continues to compare the two types of car manufacturers, using his hands to emphasize points. (3) A graphic overlay of three stylized smartphones appears: a gold iPhone at the top, followed by a grey Google Pixel and a black Xiaomi phone, illustrating his phone brand analogy. (4) The scene returns to the man in a squatting position in the driveway. He touches his chin thoughtfully and uses his hands to explain the 'closed system' concept, similar to iOS. (5) A medium close-up shot focuses on the man's face and upper body as he speaks about market share and stability. His expressions are animated and focused. (6) He stands up briefly, spreading his arms wide to pose a question about how to categorize non-Tesla car companies. (7) He squats back down, pointing a finger for emphasis while continuing his comparison. (8) A large QR code graphic with a car icon and social media group information appears at the bottom of the screen, while the man remains visible and continues talking behind it.
